name: 05-recipe-finder
public_brief: Build/fix a recipe search API: ingredients must AND (all required), max_cook_time must be an upper bound, and diet=vegetarian must include vegan recipes. Make ./test.sh pass.

defects_INTERNAL_DO_NOT_TELL_CANDIDATE.summary: Ingredient filters are combined with OR instead of requiring ALL ingredients (AND)
defects_INTERNAL_DO_NOT_TELL_CANDIDATE.fix_strategy: For each ingredient, chain qs = qs.filter(ingredients__icontains=ingredient) so every term must match.
Filter with cook_time_minutes__lte=max_cook_time so only recipes that cook in at most that many minutes are returned.

defects_INTERNAL_DO_NOT_TELL_CANDIDATE.summary: diet=vegetarian only matches exact vegetarian and excludes vegan, but product says vegetarian should include vegan
defects_INTERNAL_DO_NOT_TELL_CANDIDATE.fix_strategy: When diet is vegetarian, filter diet__in=['vegetarian', 'vegan'] (or equivalent Q OR).
